problem_statement: A message that has already been enqueued in a priority queue should not allow its priority to be changed. Attempting to set the priority of an enqueued message currently succeeds (returns success) and silently reorders the message within the queue, instead of being rejected. Such an attempt should fail, indicating the operation is not permitted while the message is queued in a priority queue, and the queue order must remain unchanged.
